faq.q: How much does Brad Johnson Injury Law charge?
faq.a: Brad Johnson Injury Law publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Brad Johnson Injury Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Brad Johnson Injury Law publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock, the firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Brad Johnson Injury Law have offices?
faq.a: Brad Johnson Injury Law publishes one office, in Glendale. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Brad Johnson Injury Law?
faq.a: Brad Johnson Injury Law names ten attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
